title: Jesus... My Younger Cousin Bought A Car 🚗
topic: at the family lunch his younger cousin showed off a new car, and he stayed inside pretending he prefers the metro

bible.text: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my younger cousin drove to the family lunch in his new car. I said I prefer the metro. 🚗

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone went out to see it. I kept eating.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You weren't hungry. You didn't want them to see your face.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: He's twenty-four. I'm thirty and still saving for a scooter.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your life isn't late. It's yours. I never measured anyone by their keys.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Next time, go out. Be glad for him, at peace with you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the cousin who always gets compared. 🚗
